dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Have you released a Xiao Lantern?

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: Between you and me... the wish I wrote on my lantern was:

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: I wish Mr. Baizhu will come to visit my house more often next year. Then I'll get to see him every day!

dialogues.speaker: Hongdou
dialogues.text: What's your wish? I promise I'll keep it a secret!
